```yaml
name: Build and Deploy Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
      uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
      with:
        registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
        scope: '@foxminchan'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install -g @vuepress/cli@next
        npm install

    - name: Create docs directory and initialize VuePress
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs
        cd docs
        npx vuepress@next init .

    - name: Setup arc42 structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs/architecture
        touch docs/architecture/01-introduction-and-goals.md
        touch docs/architecture/02-constraints.md
        touch docs/architecture/03-context-and-scope.md
        touch docs/architecture/04-solution-strategy.md
        touch docs/architecture/05-building-block-view.md
        touch docs/architecture/06-runtime-view.md
        touch docs/architecture/07-deployment-view.md
        touch docs/architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts.md
        touch docs/architecture/09-architecture-decisions.md
        touch docs/architecture/10-quality-requirements.md
        touch docs/architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt.md
        touch docs/architecture/12-glossary.md

    - name: Configure VuePress
      run: |
        cat > docs/.vuepress/config.js << EOF
        module.exports = {
          title: 'BookWorm Architecture',
          description: 'Architecture documentation for BookWorm project',
          themeConfig: {
            nav: [
              { text: 'Home', link: '/' },
              { text: 'Architecture', link: '/architecture/' }
            ],
            sidebar: [
              {
                title: 'Architecture Documentation',
                collapsable: false,
                children: [
                  '/architecture/01-introduction-and-goals',
                  '/architecture/02-constraints',
                  '/architecture/03-context-and-scope',
                  '/architecture/04-solution-strategy',
                  '/architecture/05-building-block-view',
                  '/architecture/06-runtime-view',
                  '/architecture/07-deployment-view',
                  '/architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts',
                  '/architecture/09-architecture-decisions',
                  '/architecture/10-quality-requirements',
                  '/architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt',
                  '/architecture/12-glossary'
                ]
              }
            ]
          }
        }
        EOF

    - name: Build documentation
      run: |
        cd docs
        npm run docs:build

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs/.vuepress/dist
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        commit_message: 'Deploy documentation'
```
